{{Quote|Last week Bier's warning timer went dead because of the high ionite concentration. He was in an aquasuit, out mapping the sea floor. Ran out of oxygen and didn't make it back to the tunnel.|A miner, giving an example of the dangers of ionite to Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="JA2: TDR" />}}
'''Bier''' was an individual who lived during the waning decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was a [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who worked for the [[Offworld Mining Corporation]] on an [[Deepsea mines|offshore mine]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]<ref name="JA2: TDR" /> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="TERC" /> While mapping the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floor of Bandomeer, his [[Aquasuit/Legends|aquasuit's]] [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] ran out. The warning [[Time/Legends|timer]] on his aquasuit failed to warn him of his depleting supply because of high [[ionite]] concentration, and he [[Death/Legends|died]] before he could make it it back to the tunnel. A [[Standard week/Legends|week]] later, the [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] miner [[Guerra Derida]] and [[Unidentified miner|another miner]] told the captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Agricultural Corps/Legends|Agricultural Corps]] member [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] of Bier's fate as a warning of the dangers of ionite mining.<ref name="JA2: TDR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bier was mentioned in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]'', the second novel of the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' series. The novel was published in [[1999]] and written by [[Jude Watson]].<ref name="JA2: TDR" />
